posts.author: Ranjit_DailyTrader
posts.text: Path Of Success For Traders — Chart reading is important, but demand and supply zones alone don’t guarantee success. Wicks can show price rejection, but they don’t always tell us why the price moved. Risk management, discipline, and proper backtesting matter just as much. The real skill is learning which setups actually work over time, not just finding zones on a chart.
